implementation.targetScope: Zod 3/4 full-schema adapter, nested errors and native validity helpers. Other validation adapters, Zod Mini and Standard Schema are outside verified scope.

changes: Independent implementation from public APIs and black-box comparisons; no upstream runtime copied.
No runtime dependencies or hidden Zod import; the caller supplies the schema.
Nonmutating issue traversal, safe paths, and propagation of genuine validator exceptions.

caller.scope: The application's resolver imports all use /zod, including WARML, calendar, notes, auth and account forms. The app uses Zod 3.24.3. Release and adoption are separate.
